resources.string: Hidden apps lock, incognito, offline mode
Block all network access: online search results, weather and exchange rate updates, and remote images
Breezy Weather and weather plugins keep working because they read data from apps on this device.
Ask for fingerprint, face or device PIN before showing hidden apps
Don\'t record app launches: frequently used apps and search ranking stop learning
Block screenshots and screen recording while search results or hidden apps are on screen
